mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for three consecutive weeks while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES also improved, indicating a broadening return to out-of-home routines; this momentum continues over the next four weeks and lifts RETAIL_REC above its last-28-day mean.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days despite the recent weekly gains in RETAIL_REC, TRANSIT, and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossing above zero and PARKS recovering above -15 signals a shift from strict essential-only trips to mixed errands and local outings, which raises retail-and-recreation footfall over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM > 0 and PARKS > -15 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its last-14-day mean even though GROCERY_PHARM remains above 0 and PARKS remains above -15 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT improvement combined with flat-to-falling RESIDENTIAL indicates people are leaving home for non-work trips rather than staying in; this interaction drives higher retail-and-recreation mobility over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves while RESIDENTIAL does not rise
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last-28-day mean while TRANSIT improves and RESIDENTIAL remains flat or falls.

mechanism_narrative: Under a reopening policy regime with WORKPLACES above -16 and TRANSIT above -29, offices and shared transport regain enough users to support nearby retail and recreation, pushing RETAIL_REC up over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its last-14-day mean while WORKPLACES is above -16 and TRANSIT is above -29.

mechanism_narrative: Autumn pre-holiday shopping and cooler weather shift spending toward indoor retail; with GROCERY_PHARM already positive, the seasonal reallocation lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its last-28-day mean despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining positive.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM stays above 2 while TRANSIT remains below -27.5, households are still limiting trips to essentials and avoiding shared transport; this interaction suppresses discretionary retail over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than its last-14-day mean even though GROCERY_PHARM is above 2 and TRANSIT is below -27.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp PARKS rebound combined with rising RETAIL_REC indicates renewed outdoor social activity spilling into nearby retail; the interaction produces higher RETAIL_REC within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the next 7 days is lower than its last-7-day mean while PARKS rises more than 3 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above -28 signals restored confidence in shared mobility and policy-backed reopening; once crossed, retail-and-recreation mobility rises over the following two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its last-14-day mean after TRANSIT crosses above -28 for one week.
